title: Short Story Elements — Falling Action
skills: define falling action within narrative structure
identify events that follow a story's climax
analyze how falling action develops consequences and resolves conflict
explain how falling action leads toward resolution
alignment_note: Introduces falling action as the portion of a narrative that follows the climax and develops the consequences of the story's central turning point. Supports plot analysis, sequencing, conflict resolution, and understanding of how narratives move from climax toward resolution across high school English courses.
